Read Synergy H1 time course Excel export

read_synergy_xlsx.Rd

Reads one kind of sheet from an Excel export of a time course (kinetic) run on a BioTek Synergy H1 plate reader. Each plate has Setup, Results and Raw Data sheets (for example Plate 1 - Raw Data). The sheet argument chooses which kind to read; every plate in the file is read and the plates are stacked into one table, identified by plate_id. To keep only some plates, filter on plate_id afterwards.

Usage

read_synergy_xlsx(
  path,
  sheet = c("raw", "results", "setup"),
  interval_hours = 1/3,
  thin_hours = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Path to the xlsx file.

sheet

Which kind of sheet to read: "raw" (default), "results" or "setup".

interval_hours, thin_hours

Used only when sheet = "raw". See read_logphase_txt(). The default interval is 20 minutes (1/3).

Value

A tibble. The columns depend on sheet; all have plate_id, the sheet name without the trailing sheet type (such as "Plate 1").

  • "raw": seconds, hours, well, od and plate_id.

  • "results": one row per well with plate_id, well (zero-padded), lag_hours, max_v (maximum slope of ln(OD), as reported), doubling_hours and stationary_hours.

  • "setup": plate_id, key and value.

Details

  • "raw": the optical density time courses. Processing is the same as for read_logphase_txt(). The label row above the header (such as OD590) is skipped.

  • "results": the per-well summary computed by the instrument software (lag time, maximum growth rate, doubling time and stationary phase). Times are stored by the software as Excel day fractions (or, for negative values, as text such as -3:13:23) and are converted to hours. Wells with no value (?????) are NA. The Well ID and Name rows are not read.

  • "setup": the run protocol (temperature, interval, shaking, read settings and so on) as a table of key and value. A key that spans several lines of the sheet has one row per line. The plate layout and data reduction blocks that follow the protocol are not read.

Single time point (endpoint) exports are read with read_synergy_endpoint().

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "synergy_example.xlsx", package = "plateReadeR")
read_synergy_xlsx(f)
#> # A tibble: 1,152 × 5
#>    seconds hours well     od plate_id
#>      <dbl> <dbl> <chr> <dbl> <chr>   
#>  1       0 0     A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  2    1200 0.333 A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  3    2400 0.667 A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  4    3600 1     A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  5    4800 1.33  A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  6    6000 1.67  A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  7    7200 2     A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  8    8400 2.33  A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#>  9    9600 2.67  A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#> 10   10800 3     A01   0.089 Plate 1 
#> # ℹ 1,142 more rows
read_synergy_xlsx(f, sheet = "results")
#> # A tibble: 96 × 6
#>    plate_id well  lag_hours  max_v doubling_hours stationary_hours
#>    <chr>    <chr>     <dbl>  <dbl>          <dbl>            <dbl>
#>  1 Plate 1  A01        5.42  0              26.5             9.33 
#>  2 Plate 1  B01       15.7   0.007           1.60           23.1  
#>  3 Plate 1  C01       NA    -0.004          -3.22            0.456
#>  4 Plate 1  D01       30.1  -0.003          -3.96           26.1  
#>  5 Plate 1  E01        6.96  0              25.6             9.57 
#>  6 Plate 1  F01        5.48  0.002           6.96           10.8  
#>  7 Plate 1  G01       15.0   0.008           1.42           21.8  
#>  8 Plate 1  H01       27.9   0.002           7.69           34.5  
#>  9 Plate 1  A02       21.1   0.008           1.47           28.7  
#> 10 Plate 1  B02       NA     0              40.8             2.41 
#> # ℹ 86 more rows
read_synergy_xlsx(f, sheet = "setup")
#> # A tibble: 12 × 3
#>    plate_id key                       value                                     
#>    <chr>    <chr>                     <chr>                                     
#>  1 Plate 1  Plate Type                96 WELL PLATE (Use plate lid)             
#>  2 Plate 1  Eject plate on completion NA                                        
#>  3 Plate 1  Set Temperature           Setpoint 30°C, Gradient 0,0 °C            
#>  4 Plate 1  Set Temperature           Preheat before moving to next step        
#>  5 Plate 1  Start Kinetic             Runtime 48:00:00 (HH:MM:SS), Interval 0:2…
#>  6 Plate 1  Shake                     Orbital: 0:10 (MM:SS)                     
#>  7 Plate 1  Shake                     Frequency: 425 cpm (3 mm)

#>  9 Plate 1  Read                      Full Plate                                
#> 10 Plate 1  Read                      Wavelengths: 590                          
#> 11 Plate 1  Read                      Read Speed: Normal, Delay: 100 msec, Meas…
